body:
friends.html now links to IDUNA's hosted SSO page instead of rendering its own DEADWEIGHT email/password form, matching store.html's SECTION 543 cutover. Uses the new IDUNA sso-exchange endpoint (see the paired IDUNA Apple) to turn the generic SSO login into a real, usable DEADWEIGHT player token before storing it. An IDUNA identity with no DEADWEIGHT account linked gets a real, honest error pointing at the DEADWEIGHT client's own link-email flow. Node-syntax-checked; the IDUNA-side round trip is proven end to end by real Go tests; the actual browser click-through was not screenshotted (no headless Chrome in this sandbox) -- named honestly in WOTAN/CLAUDE.md, not claimed as fully verified. WOTAN 48ac697. Deploy (~/wotan-deploy.sh) and the paired iduna.service restart are still needed to go live -- both blocked on the founder by this session's own production-deploy restriction.

⚓ ☃
title: friends.html drops its own DEADWEIGHT password form, uses IDUNA SSO via the new sso-exchange bridge
